scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
Lu~lu~lu~lu~
Lu~ Huh?

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
Wow, you must be a beginner, right?
What an innocent face! Ha~ hahaha.

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text: Why don't you do some hunting outside instead of walking around and wasting your time?
I am about to leave now.
I've got a Hunting Mission.

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
Oh, well. Then, go figure.
Bye~ bye.

Hunting Poison Spore
Hunting Smokie

Hunting Coco

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
{0}!
Wow, I didn't expect you would do that mission. I was just about to give up. But you did good job. I appreciate it!

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
Well, I requested the mission and you did an excellent job.
I will give you a reward as I promised.

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text: Here it is. Thank you very much. God bless you!

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text: Oh, you are right.

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
But, you haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come to me now? You haven't completed the mission!
I will give you a reward if you complete the mission. Ok? Are we good?

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text:
{0}
You can check the world map by pressing 'ctrl + ~' key.

scripts.speaker: Sponiac
scripts.text: Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!

scripts.speaker: Sponiac

It is weird.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
Hu hu~~ we are delivery men~
We are faster than any flight~!

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
Welcome~ welcome!
We are the fastest delivery company, Dieshin Corperation.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: How can I help you?
I don't need help.
I've got a Delivery Mission.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: Oh, well. Then, go figure. Bye~!

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
Deliver an Insecticide.
Deliver Honey.
Deliver Blankets.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: Wait, but you already have a delivery box.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: We can't allow you to deliver two boxes at once. So, please finish your delivery first.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: If you forgot where to deliver, then please check Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
Ah ha! I got it!
The insecticide? It must be the Zoologist on the southeast of Payon who ordered the Insecticide.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
Ah ha! I got it!
Honey? It must be the Entomologist at the west of St. Capitolina Abbey, wich is northeast of Prontera who ordered the Honey.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text:
Oh, Right!
The blankets! It must be the biologist in the south of Lutie field who ordered the blankets.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: You can can go to Lutie by asking Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: Dieshin's cooperation motive is to give the fastest and credited delivery. So please deliver it now without any delay.

scripts.speaker: Dieshin Man
scripts.text: If you forgot where to make the delivery, then please check the Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text:
Have you heard of a monster named Bigfoot?
It looks like a bear with red fur and has a 'X' shape scar on his shoulder.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: According to the recent research, flies and Bigfoot monsters have a symbiotic relationship.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: I am currently studying about it and try to prove the theory. So I plan to kill the flies around Bigfoot and observe his reaction.
...I am not interested.
Here is the Insecticide.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: Oh, I need an Insecticide to continue the study.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text:
Huh?
You are not Dieshin's delivery man?

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: I am waiting for a special delivery.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: Oh ho! Yes! That one!

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: That is the Insecticide that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text:
I have been waiting for this!
Give it to me!

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test it right away!

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text:
I appreciate your kindness.
But, what did you bring?

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.

scripts.speaker: Zoologist
scripts.text: Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.

scripts.text:

It's shaped like an insect with black sleek skin and it has a giant horn it's head.

scripts.speaker: Entomologist
scripts.text: Recent research came out and showed that this monster can be tamed and trained by Honey.

scripts.speaker: Entomologist
scripts.text: I am currently studying about it and trying to prove the theory. So I plan to set a Honey trap on the places he usually passes and observe his reaction.
...I am not interested.
Here is the Honey.

scripts.speaker: Biologist
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?

scripts.speaker: Biologist
scripts.text:
Have you heard about the Marin monster?
It does look like the usual poring, but it has unique characteristic.

scripts.speaker: Biologist
scripts.text: Porings steal items if they see them on the ground. However, Marin has no interest in dropped items. So I was wondering, how come Marin doesn't pay attention to gathering items even though they are the same kind of monster as Porings.

scripts.speaker: Biologist
scripts.text: But, this place is freaking cold.
...I am not interested.
Here are the blankets.

scripts.speaker: Biologist
scripts.text: Huh, whatever. But be careful! It's very slippery here.

scripts.text:
Huh?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Here is some hair~ a broken clock~!

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Broken clock..? Hu hu..

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Hey~! Dude! You look like a very rich adventurer.
I am a poor adventurer.
I have a gathering mission.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Really? Hmm, oh right. You don't look sophisticated.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You are a poor adventurer~! Good luck!

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
Gather Bones
Gather Animal Skin
Gather Peelings
Gather Tails
Gather Cookies
Gather Mustaches

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Skel-Bones?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You don't have enough 'Skel-Bones'... You can find it when you hunt Skeletons.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: To find Skeletons, you better check Payon Dungeon 1F, which is located in Archer Village, north of Payon.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where is the Bear's Footskins and Animal Skins?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
You have to bring 10 Bear's Footskins' and '5 Animal Skins!
You can find Bear's Footskin from Bigfoot and Animal Skin from Animals.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Bigfoot is around the north of Geffen field or the southeast of Payon field.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Worm Peelings and Garlets?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You have to bring '20 Worm Peelings' and '20 Garlets' to complete the mission.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You can get those items from 'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro', 'Vitata', 'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug'.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: 'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro' and 'Vitata' are in Ant Hell which is located near the Saint Darmain Fortress soutwest of Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: 'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug' are int he Prontere Culvert. To get there, you need to be a volunteer of the Prontera Culvert's punitive force.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Yoyo Tails, Acorns and Raccoon Leafs?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '10 Yoyo Tails,' '10 Acorns' and '10 Raccoon Leafs' to complete the mission.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You can get Yoyo Tails from 'Yoyo's', Acorn from 'Coco's' and Raccoon Leaf from 'Smokies'.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: You can find them easily around fields, but the field east of Ayothaya is the best spot for hunting all 3 monsters.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: To get to Ayothaya, you better go to 'Aibakthing' in Alberta and pay his fare.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Well-baked Cookies and the Piece of Cake?

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Well-baked Cookies' and '1 Piece of Cake' to complete the mission.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
You can get Well-baked Cookie from 'Cookies' who wears red or green shirts.
For getting Piece of Cake, you should look for 'Mystcases'.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Both monsters canbe found in the Toy Factory Warehouse or Toy Monitoring Room. To get there, ask Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Mole Whiskerss and Mole Claws??

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Mole Whiskers' and '3 Mole Claws' to complete the mission.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
You can get those items from 'Martins'.
Martins can be found in the Mjolnir Dead Pit, but the second floor is dangerous, so be careful!

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: To get there, ask a Kafra Employee in Geffen, they can warp you there.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Wow~ you did an excellent job!

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text: Thank you very much. God bless you!

scripts.speaker: Dashia
scripts.text:
Ha~! Ha~!
I will give you a reward as promised.
